bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 172, Number 15 (Thursday, January 22, 2026)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. LAWLER:
H.R. 7219.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I Section 8 Clause 18 of the U.S. Constitution
[Page H1351]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on the Judiciary, and in addition to the Committees on Oversight and Government Reform, and House Administration, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
